# NESSIE Design System

> NESSIE is the NS (Dutch Railways) design system. This repo is an agent skill for designing and auditing app screens against it, iOS-first: tokens only, components first, dark mode automatic, accessibility built in. The reference docs are self-contained markdown, synced from the NS ZeroHeight.

This file is the map. The playbook is `AGENTS.md`: read it before producing any design output, then the skill file for the task, then only the reference files you need. Every link below is the raw markdown of a file in the repo; relative links inside those files resolve against the same base. Generated by `tools/llms/build.mjs`, never hand-edited.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/AGENTS.md): entry point — context detection, skill routing table, reference map, non-negotiable rules
- [Audit a screen (NESSIE, iOS-first)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/skills/audit-screen.md): Use when the user wants an existing Figma screen, frame, or component checked against NESSIE guidelines — components, tokens, layout, accessibility, and brand
- [Audit tokens (NESSIE)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/skills/audit-tokens.md): Focused, token-only check. Use when the user wants to verify that a Figma screen/frame/component uses NESSIE design tokens correctly — without the full screen…
- [Build a screen (NESSIE, iOS-first)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/skills/build-screen.md): Use when the user wants to design or generate a new screen, view, component composition, or flow in Figma / Figma Make using the NESSIE design system
- [Document a component (NESSIE, iOS-first)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/skills/document-component.md): Use when creating or updating a `reference/components/<kebab>.md` doc for a NESSIE App component. Produces a doc that matches the house standard so it's…

## Components

- [Component index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/index.md): master catalog — pick a component here first, then open its own file
- [Button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/button.md): Buttons — Primary on-screen action; types Brand/Primary/Secondary/Tertiary/Link, plus Icon-only and Floating, sizes, destructive/inverted/loading
- [Button Group](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/button-group.md): Buttons — Group two or three related actions (one primary + tertiary others)
- [Bottom Navigation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/bottom-navigation.md): Navigation — Persistent switch between top-level destinations
- [Top Bar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/top-bar.md): Navigation — Screen title, back option, contextual actions, branding
- [Tabs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/tabs.md): Navigation — Navigate between related, same-level content groups
- [Sticky Footer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/sticky-footer.md): Navigation — One or two important CTAs pinned to the bottom
- [Input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/input.md): Forms — Text/number entry; types Text/Email/Number/Password/Price/Read-only
- [Textarea Input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/textarea-input.md): Forms — Multi-line free-form text
- [Label](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/label.md): Forms — Names a form control; placed above the input
- [Help Text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/help-text.md): Forms — In-context help after the label
- [Error Message](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/error-message.md): Forms — Inline form validation error
- [Checkboxes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/checkboxes.md): Forms — Select any number of options from a list
- [Radio Buttons](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/radio-buttons.md): Forms — Select exactly one from mutually exclusive options
- [Radio Panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/radio-panel.md): Forms — Pick one of 2–3 short options side by side
- [Toggle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/toggle.md): Forms — Switch a feature on/off with immediate effect
- [Select](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/select.md): Forms — One choice from ~7–15 options via native menu
- [Selectable](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/selectable.md): Forms — Single/multi-select set of content tiles (form tokens)
- [OTP Input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/otp-input.md): Forms — Enter a one-time verification code
- [Stepper](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/stepper.md): Forms — Increase/decrease a numerical value near a default
- [Date Input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/date-input.md): Forms — Enter a known date (e.g. date of birth)
- [Date Picker Input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/date-picker-input.md): Forms — Schedule a date via input + native picker
- [Time Picker Input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/time-picker-input.md): Forms — Schedule a time via input + native picker
- [Range Slider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/range-slider.md): Forms — Select a value within a numeric range
- [Chipcard Input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/chipcard-input.md): Forms — Enter an OV-chipkaart number
- [Creditcard Input](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/creditcard-input.md): Forms — Enter a credit card number (auto type/format)
- [Message Inline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/message-inline.md): Feedback — Contextual status within a page; Default/Expandable/Navigate
- [Message Bar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/message-bar.md): Feedback — System-level message below the Top Bar
- [Message Toast](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/message-toast.md): Feedback — Brief confirmation feedback, auto-dismiss
- [Badge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/badge.md): Feedback — Count or status indicator on another element
- [Loader](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/loader.md): Feedback — Indeterminate loading (>3s)
- [Skeleton](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/skeleton.md): Feedback — Shaped placeholder while content loads (>2s)
- [Highlight Box](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/highlight-box.md): Feedback — Make non-critical info jump out; lighter than Message Inline
- [Feature Tip](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/feature-tip.md): Feedback — Coachmark introducing a feature
- [Dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/dialog.md): Feedback — Interruptive alert requiring acknowledgment (iOS native)
- [List Items](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/list-items.md): Content — Vertical list of related info/actions; Base + prefabs
- [Text List Items](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/text-list-items.md): Content — Text-only list; Ordered/Unordered/Checked
- [Tiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/tiles.md): Content — Group related info/actions as a card; entry point to detail
- [Bottom Sheet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/bottom-sheet.md): Content — Supplementary content surface over the primary UI
- [Section Heading](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/section-heading.md): Content — Name a section and host actions scoped to it (show all, collapse, dismiss); optional content slot
- [Expandable](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/expandable.md): Content — Show/hide sections; List or Stand-alone
- [Chips](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/chips.md): Content — Filter content, trigger actions, or dismiss a choice
- [Sticker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/sticker.md): Content — Highlight contextual info on a nearby element
- [Tag](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/tag.md): Content — Inline line/route number or platform/track location
- [Price](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/price.md): Content — Display an amount of money
- [Dividers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/dividers.md): Content — Separate content groups; Default/Brand
- [Link](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/link.md): Content — Button styled as a link ("Read more", external, attachment)
- [Image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/image.md): Content — Visual support with fixed aspect ratios
- [Icon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/icon.md): Content — NES icon by name/size (retrieval API documented)
- [Hero](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/hero.md): Content — Attention-grabbing page intro with image + title
- [Journey Pill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/journey-pill.md): Domain — Compact pill for a journey leg/transfer/expand
- [Travel Cards](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/travel-cards.md): Domain — Show a travel card's status, balance, check-in
- [Route](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/route.md): Domain — Stations/carriers along a route, with times/delays/platforms
- [Rush](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/rush.md): Domain — Indicate how busy a train is
- [Receipt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/receipt.md): Domain — Live calculated price outcome of a form
- [From To](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/components/from-to.md): Domain — Departure/arrival/via input for the travel planner

## Tokens and fundamentals

Load these in pairs: the tokens file holds the values (vocabulary), its fundamentals file says which token to pick when (usage).

- [Color Tokens](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/tokens/color.md): Semantic color reference for designing/auditing iOS-first NS app screens. Pick base (semantic) or applied (component) tokens — never core/raw, never hex. Dark…
- [Using Color](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/fundamentals/color.md): Pick by meaning, never by swatch. Dark mode resolves automatically, so you never hand-pick a light-mode step or set a dark override
- [Typography Tokens](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/tokens/typography.md): Type-style reference for NS app screens. Pick a semantic preset (heading/body/label/…) — never raw font sizes, never hardcoded weights. Font is NS Sans…
- [Using Typography](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/fundamentals/typography.md): A preset carries size, weight, leading, and tracking together. Pick a preset by the role the text plays, and never recombine a size with a different weight or…
- [Spacing & Dimension Tokens](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/tokens/spacing.md): Spacing, control-height, and icon-size reference for NS app layouts. Pick semantic space tokens — never raw dimension steps, never invented values. Values are…
- [App Layout System](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/fundamentals/layout.md): Choose layout density by what the user is doing in a section, not by screen size
- [Shape Tokens (Radius & Border Width)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/tokens/shape.md): Corner-radius and border-width reference for NS app surfaces. Pick semantic radius/width tokens — never raw radius steps, never invented values. Values are px…
- [Using Shape & Style](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/fundamentals/style.md): The radius scale is sparse by design. Round to the nearest token and flag the gap rather than inventing a value
- [Motion Tokens](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/tokens/motion.md): Duration & easing reference for NS app transitions and animations. Pick semantic motion tokens — never raw ms values, never invented curves
- [Using Motion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/fundamentals/motion.md): Navigation structure (top bar, tabs vs bottom navigation, back navigation) is defined in `layout.md` (Navigation region). The transient surfaces themselves…
- [Applied Tokens](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/tokens/applied.md): Component-level (tier 3) tokens: pre-composed values for form states, interaction states, skeleton, modality, and layout. Use an applied token when one exists…

## Patterns

Patterns outrank components for "which one should I use". Start with Interaction Models.

- [Feedback & States](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/patterns/feedback-states.md): How the NS app tells the user that something is empty, loading, missing, or broken — and which surface to use in each situation. This page is about choosing…
- [Interaction Models](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/patterns/interaction-models.md): How users perform actions that require a choice, adjustment, or task completion across the NS app on iOS and Android. Intent drives the choice, not visual…
- [Settings & Utility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/patterns/settings-utility.md): How settings, preferences, and utility-related UI behave across the NS app. Applies to dedicated Settings areas (Mijn NS settings, notification preferences),…

## Content (UX writing)

- [UX writing for NESSIE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/content/index.md): How we write for web and app. This is UX writing, not copywriting: functional text that helps a traveller reach their goal, in the voice of NS. Wording rules…
- [Breadcrumb](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/content/breadcrumb.md): Wording for breadcrumbs. Breadcrumbs are primarily a web pattern; on app, back navigation lives in `../fundamentals/layout.md` (Navigation region)
- [Button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/content/button.md): Button copy is 2–4 words and always leads to action. See the component itself in `../components/button.md`
- [Empty state](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/content/empty-state.md): Wording for an empty content area. For *when* to use an Empty State vs another surface, and its variants, see `../patterns/feedback-states.md`. (The Empty…
- [Error message](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/content/error-message.md): Wording for errors that surface in Message Inline, Message Toast, or Message Bar. For *which surface* to use, see `../patterns/feedback-states.md`; for the…
- [Link](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/content/link.md): Link text must convey what appears once it's followed. See the component in `../components/link.md`

## Design language and accessibility

- [Design Language](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/design-language.md): NS is the Dutch national railway. Digital products should feel like a warm, human conversation with a colleague — never bureaucratic or cold
- [Accessibility (design-level rules)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gertjankooy/nessie/main/reference/accessibility.md): In the Netherlands ~1 million travellers face accessibility challenges (visual, auditory, motor). Train travel is essential to their participation in society,…
